critical_code_review_comments: modules_service.save_job/save_client/save_vendor/save_template/save_tag: run 'required fields' validation on both create and update paths. On update this makes PUT non-idempotent for partial payloads (returns 400). Prefer requiring fields only when creating, or merge with existing doc before validating on update.

modules_service.list_integrations returns the masked map from db.integrations.fields['fields'] which already stores the mask string at save time (e.g. '••••SECRET'), never the raw. Good. However the inline expression 'masked[f] = _mask(rec.get("_dec", {}).get(f)) if False else ...' is dead code (branch always False) and confusing — remove the false branch.

modules_service.convert_application: when an existing lead with the same phone_normalized is found, endpoint updates the application to status='converted' without creating a follow-up or activity for the existing lead. Consider writing a merge activity for auditability.
modules_service.import_commit: 'assign=auto' pool includes team_leader role in addition to recruiter. Same finding as prior iteration — confirm business intent.

modules_service.import_preview stores the ENTIRE uploaded CSV/XLSX (data_rows) into MongoDB under db.import_batches for up to 2 hours. For a 5MB CSV this can be tens of thousands of rows per user — consider TTL index on expires_at and/or storing on disk for large files.

action_required endpoint enforces admin/recruiters.view/users.manage via inline check, but recruiters are the ones with the actual overdue/no-followup/never-called workload. Consider a recruiter-scoped variant so recruiters can see their own actionable items rather than a 403.

modules_routes.import_preview + import_commit: both use require_permission('imports.run'). commit_requires_phone_mapping test confirms 400 is returned. Good. But there is no validation that commit is called by the same actor who ran preview — any user with imports.run could commit another user's batch_id (batch['actor_id'] is stored but never checked).
notifications list endpoint: no pagination — returns all notifications unbounded. For long-running users this will grow.
modules_service.list_templates does not scope by ownership; all users see all templates. If templates are ever role/team-scoped, revisit.

modules_service.save_integration deletes-and-replaces secrets_enc entirely on each save. If UI sends only ONE of many fields (e.g. rotating webhook token), the other stored fields are wiped. Verify UI always resends the full field set or switch save to merge-update.
